post_processing.floors: One-pixel matching opposing-edge conditioning on all nine standalone floor textures.
post_processing.display: All preview enlargement uses nearest-neighbour sampling.
post_processing.animations: Four distinct frames selected from each five-image result; sheets preserve native size.
post_processing.provider: PixelLab API v2; Pro Flash for core reference-guided props and floor textures, Pixen for smaller props, animation v3 for loops, standard square tileset for transitions.
